job.name: design4-bento
job.meaning: Бенто-сетка: плитки разного размера, крупная типографика, лаймовый акцент
job.prompt: Website landing page design concept, full desktop page shown as one tall screenshot cropped to 16:9, for a Russian service that produces AI videos with a digital presenter (avatar) for corporate training, online courses, experts and products. Russian-language interface. Main headline exactly: «Видео без съёмок». Button labels exactly: «Смотреть примеры» and «Рассчитать стоимость». Small "LOGO" placeholder in the top-left. Other small text can be neat placeholder lines. No real brand names. Modern 2026 web design, professional UI, crisp, high quality. Style: BENTO GRID. The page is built from rounded tiles of different sizes: a big tile with a digital presenter video, a tall tile with a vertical phone video, small tiles with icons and big numbers («60 сек», «10 языков», «от 1 000 ₽»), a tile with a voice waveform. Bold oversized typography, off-white background, black text, one bright accent color (lime green). Trendy Apple-style bento layout.
